concept: Building something (a project, a skill, a small venture) from nothing through your own initiative
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student identifies a real idea they could build or start, and works through the first real steps of turning it into something
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides how to move from idea to first concrete action
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what the very first real step would actually be

assessment.success_marker: student identifies a genuine, concrete first step, not just an idea they'd like to eventually pursue
